title: x402 challenge, as served
description: The shape of an x402 payment-required challenge on the wire, used to classify the frozen fixtures in spec/fixtures/. This is DESCRIPTIVE, not a validator: the authoritative decoder is decodePaymentRequired from tx402, and a payload that satisfies this schema can still be rejected by it (strict base64, byte cap, depth cap, duplicate keys, resource-origin check). Fixtures marked expect:invalid here are the ones that fail even this loose shape.
